header.title: AFT BLOCK C: DANFOSS PVG 32 - 5 FUNCTIONS / HYDRAULIC SYSTEM

notes: Small printed cartridge/part numbers (e.g. 11166838, 11166832, 157B5111, 157B6203, 157B7121, 157B7126, 157B2014, 125/135/240/260 pressure setting labels) are illegible at this resolution. Several red handwritten/annotation notes with pressure adjustment instructions (e.g. increasing LSA settings from 225 to 260 bar, ON/OFF relief valve from 150 to 225 bar) are present but details near EV-10.1/10.2/10.3 handwritten pressure check notes (43 bar opening/170 bar closing, 175 bar) are hard to fully confirm. Red warning triangle markers with numeric labels (10) appear near several components - exact association unclear at this resolution.

flow_scenarios: Neutral (de-energized): spool held in open-neutral position by spring/pilot default; P connects through open-center path to T, both A and B ports blocked or connected to tank depending on drawn open-center path — oil recirculates P->T, no flow to actuator

Energized OPEN (B active): PVEO solenoid 11166838 shifts pilot, main spool moves so P->B port supplies flow to open the transom door actuator, opposite port A returns to T rail; pressure to be checked ~45 bar in opening per handwritten note
Energized CLOSE (A active): spool shifts opposite direction, P->A port supplies flow to close the transom door, B returns to T; pressure to be checked ~170 bar in closing per handwritten note
Over-pressure at B (closing/opening limit): if B-line pressure exceeds 125 bar setting, relief cartridge (125) opens dumping excess flow to T rail
Over-pressure at A: if A-line pressure exceeds 195 bar setting, relief cartridge (195) opens dumping excess flow to T rail
Load sense: whichever work port is pressurized, LS shuttle passes that pressure to the LS rail feeding pump compensator (off-sheet to the right)

flow_scenarios: Neutral (open-centre): spool in mid/2° position passes pump flow straight through P-to-T open-center path across the module; A and B work ports blocked/isolated from pressure, LS line unloaded to tank.

Energized to A (1° or 3° per PVEO logic): P -> spool -> A work port -> through counterbalance/load-holding cartridge 157B7126 -> to winch/cylinder off-sheet; return flow from B port -> spool -> T rail; LS signal taken from A branch feeds LS_A limiter.
Energized to B (2° position): P -> spool -> B work port -> off-sheet load; return from A port -> through counterbalance check path -> spool -> T; LS signal from B branch feeds LS_B line.

Over-pressure on A/B work ports: if pressure in either work-port branch exceeds its local relief setting (240 bar on one branch, 260 bar on the other), the respective relief cartridge opens and dumps excess flow to the local T/return rail.
LS over-pressure: LSA limiter opens at 225 bar (adjustable) to bleed the load-sense line to the return/LS rail, capping maximum LS-commanded pump pressure for this section.

ON/OFF relief block: independent small relief valve on the separate A/B 1/4"G pilot circuit opens at its 225 bar setting, limiting pressure in that dedicated pilot/control line, dumping via its own port to the line running off the bottom of the crop.

cartridges.role: main directional control spool for function EV-10.7
cartridges.position_in_flow: body ports labeled A (1/4"G, top) and B (1/4"G, bottom); P/T connections run upward into manifold body toward the pressure/return rails at top of crop (off-sheet upward)

cartridges.role: work-port relief valve, appears set inline above the main spool block near top, venting to the return/tank rail
cartridges.position_in_flow: sits between the blue P-line branch and the cyan return rail near top of sub-circuit; outlet ties into cyan dashed/return line running down the right side
cartridges.setting: marked "260" — likely a pressure setting in bar, value not fully confirmed

cartridges.role: pilot-operated check / shuttle element (drawn as the "><" crossed-line symbol) sandwiched between the relief cartridge and the LS line
cartridges.position_in_flow: inline in the pilot/LS branch, between the top relief cartridge and the LS_A tee point

cartridges.role: secondary check/orifice pair (two small circle-slash "<o>" symbols stacked) in the vertical pilot line feeding the main spool block
cartridges.position_in_flow: two instances: one just below the relief/shuttle group, one lower near the LS tee — both sit in the cyan pilot/LS line running down to LS_A

flow_scenarios: Energized: P (from top rail, blue solid line) -> spool -> A port (1/4"G) supplies load; return flow from B port -> spool -> T (cyan dashed return rail) -> off-sheet upward
De-energized/neutral: spring returns spool to rest position; ports A and B are blocked/centered per spool symbol, no flow shown to work ports in this crop
Relief scenario: if pressure in P line upstream of spool exceeds the '260' setting, the top relief cartridge opens and dumps to the cyan return/tank rail, protecting the circuit

LS branch: load-sense signal is picked off at LS_A tee point via the pilot line with in-line check/orifice elements, routed upward off-sheet to the LS manifold (line 157B2014 traced up the right side)
settings: 260 (units not confirmed, likely bar) — relief/limiter cartridge near top of function block
ports: A: 1/4"G, connects to main spool top port, load line (destination off-sheet, runs upward through crop)
B: 1/4"G, connects to main spool bottom port, line runs downward off the bottom edge of the crop (off-sheet)
illegible: Exact part/cartridge identifiers for spool and check/orifice symbols not legible
Full numeric value and units of the '260' marking not fully confirmed (could be pressure setting or size code)
Line callouts '...03' (top-left, partially cropped) and '157B2014' meaning/routing beyond crop edge not traceable
